1	## OfficeFloor REST endpoints
2	
3	Applies when adding or changing REST endpoints. This project serves REST through
4	OfficeFloor Function Injection, **not** Spring MVC controllers: each endpoint is a
5	pipeline of small function classes wired together in YAML.
6	
7	- Requires the OfficeFloor Spring Boot starter in the build:
8	  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter` (Spring Boot 4.x) or
9	  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-3-starter` (Spring Boot 3.x). Without it these YAML
10	  files are inert. (Rules below track these starter versions.)
11	- Define each endpoint as a YAML file under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/`,
12	  named `<path>.<METHOD>.yml` (e.g. `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` → `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`).
13	- One small function class per step; compose steps with `next:` and `outputs:`.
14	- Do NOT generate `@RestController`, `@GetMapping` or `@PostMapping`.
15	- Transactions: `govern: [ transaction ]` on steps, not `@Transactional`.
16	- Errors: a handler YAML in `officefloor/escalation/`, not `@ControllerAdvice`.
17	
18	### Worked example — `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`
19	
20	The whole shape of an endpoint. The sections after this one are the reference.
21	
22	`src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`
23	
24	```yaml
25	# First step runs first. Validate before Load so an invalid body is a 400,
26	# not masked by a 404 for a missing owner.
27	validate:
28	  class: com.example.owner.ValidateOwner
29	  next: load
30	load:
31	  class: com.example.owner.LoadOwner
32	  next: apply
33	apply:
34	  class: com.example.owner.ApplyOwner
35	  govern: [ transaction ]
36	  next: save
37	save:
38	  class: com.example.owner.SaveOwner
39	  govern: [ transaction ]
40	  next: respond
41	respond:
42	  class: com.example.owner.RespondWithOwner
43	```
44	
45	```java
46	// One public method each. State moves by Out<T> (set) → @Val (read), matched by type.
47	public class ValidateOwner {
48	  public void validate(@RequestBody @Valid OwnerRequest request, Out<OwnerRequest> body) {
49	    body.set(request); // body read once here; republished for later steps
50	  }
51	}
52	public class LoadOwner {
53	  public void load(@PathVariable("ownerId") int ownerId, OwnerRepository repository,
54	      Out<Owner> ownerOut) throws OwnerNotFoundException {
55	    Owner owner = repository.findById(ownerId);
56	    if (owner == null) throw new OwnerNotFoundException(ownerId); // handled below
57	    ownerOut.set(owner);
58	  }
59	}
60	public class ApplyOwner { // @Val yields the stored object, not a copy — mutate in place
61	  public void apply(@Val OwnerRequest request, @Val Owner owner) {
62	    owner.setFirstName(request.firstName());
63	    owner.setLastName(request.lastName());
64	  }
65	}
66	public class SaveOwner {
67	  public void save(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository repository) {
68	    repository.save(owner);
69	  }
70	}
71	public class RespondWithOwner {
72	  public void respond(@Val Owner owner, ObjectResponse<OwnerResponse> response) {
73	    response.send(OwnerResponse.from(owner)); // this step responds; 200 by default
74	  }
75	}
76	```
77	
78	`src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/com.example.owner.OwnerNotFoundException.yml`
79	
80	```yaml
81	handle:
82	  class: com.example.owner.HandleOwnerNotFound
83	```
84	
85	```java
86	public class HandleOwnerNotFound {
87	  public void handle(@Parameter OwnerNotFoundException ex,
88	      ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<String>> response) {
89	    response.send(new ResponseEntity<>(ex.getMessage(), HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));
90	  }
91	}
92	```
93	
94	### Step wiring
95	
96	Each top-level YAML entry is a developer-chosen step name; the first is the entry
97	point. `class:` names the function. **Give each function class exactly one public
98	method** — several public methods fail at start-up unless every reference adds
99	`method:`.
100	
101	- `next: <step>` — run that step afterwards. This step's return value arrives there
102	  as `@Parameter T`.
103	- `outputs: { <name>: <step> }` — conditional branches. Declare a
104	  `@FunctionalInterface` parameter annotated `@Flow("<name>")` and call it to take the
105	  branch; not calling it short-circuits.
106	
107	### Function parameters
108	
109	Declare only what the step needs; they resolve by role:
110	
111	- `@PathVariable`, `@RequestParam`, `@RequestBody` — Spring MVC annotations work.
112	- Spring beans (repositories, mappers, services) — injected by type as normal.
113	- `ObjectResponse<T>` (`net.officefloor.web.ObjectResponse`) — send the response with
114	  `response.send(dto)`. This is how a step responds; wrap as
115	  `ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<T>>` to set status explicitly.
116	- `@Parameter T` (`net.officefloor.plugin.section.clazz.Parameter`) — the previous
117	  step's return value, a `@Flow` argument, or a thrown escalation.
118	
119	### Passing state between steps — `Out<T>` / `@Val`
120	
121	Steps do not call each other. Beyond the single `@Parameter` hand-off, publish state
122	into a variable (`net.officefloor.plugin.variable`):
123	
124	- Producer declares `Out<T>` and calls `set(...)`; consumer declares `@Val T`.
125	- Matching is **by type** — two variables of the same type in one pipeline need a
126	  `@Qualifier` annotation to disambiguate.
127	- `@Val` yields the same object the producer stored, **not a copy** — so an `Apply`
128	  step mutates the entity in place and later steps see the change.
129	
130	### Naming
131	
132	Verb plus entity: `Load<E>` (fetch by path variable, publishes `Out<E>`, throws when
133	absent) · `Build<E>` (construct from body) · `Validate<E>` (bind and validate the body,
134	publish it) · `Apply<E>` (mutate) · `Save<E>` · `Delete<E>` · `RespondWith<E>` (200) ·
135	`RespondWith<E>Created` (201) · `RespondWithNoContent` (204).
136	
137	Keep DTOs at the edges — request body in at the first step, response DTO out at the
138	responder. Steps in between work with entities.
139	
140	### Request body and validation
141	
142	- The HTTP body can be read only once: **only one step per pipeline may bind
143	  `@RequestBody`**. A second binding fails at runtime. When later steps need it, the
144	  first step publishes it as a variable.
145	- `@Valid` runs before that step's method body, so step order decides when validation
146	  happens. Put the validating step first — otherwise a missing id returns 404 before an
147	  invalid body can return 400.
148	
149	### Transactions
150	
151	`govern: [ transaction ]` for writes, `govern: [ readonly-transaction ]` for reads,
152	listed on **every** step it covers. Both are provided by the starter. Governance spans
153	the pipeline, so the request commits once at the end.
154	
155	### Errors
156	
157	Functions throw; handlers respond. The exception must be **checked** (`extends
158	Exception`) so it appears in the `throws` clause. Put the handler in
159	`officefloor/escalation/<fully.qualified.ExceptionClass>.yml`, taking the exception as
160	`@Parameter` and responding via `ObjectResponse`. Matching is most-specific-first;
161	anything unmatched falls through to Spring `@RestControllerAdvice`.
162	
163	### Security
164	
165	Guard a whole endpoint file with a Spring Security SpEL expression:
166	
167	```yaml
168	composition:
169	  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"
170	```
171	
172	- Full reference: https://officefloor.net/llms.txt

I have a complete picture. Here is my report.

## Summary

This is a Spring PetClinic REST app converted to **OfficeFloor function injection** (not Spring MVC). The owner-identity logic lives in a pipeline of small function classes under `rest/function/owner/`, plus derived getters on the `Owner` entity. An acceptance test already encodes the target redesign: `customerCode` must change from the current `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` to `<REGION>-<HASH8>`.

## 1 & 2. Relevant files, with the key code

### The redesign target (test that must pass)
**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`** (16 lines)
- Line 7 doc: *"Redesign owner identity. The customerCode must become '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is t..."* (truncated).
- Lines 11-15: `coreCustomerCodeIsRegionHash()` creates an owner with a postcode, fetches it, and asserts:
  ```java
  assertTrue(n.get("customerCode").asText().matches("[A-Z0-9]+-[0-9A-F]{8}")); // <REGION>-<HASH8>
  ```
  The current implementation produces `LON-SMI-0007`-style codes, which do **not** match `[A-Z0-9]+-[0-9A-F]{8}`, so this test currently fails. REGION here is the owner's `locality` (e.g. `NSW`); HASH8 is 8 upper-case hex chars.

### customerCode / sequence number construction
**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/BuildOwner.java`** (71 lines) — THE file to edit for the customerCode format.
- Line 19: `owner.setCustomerCode(nextCustomerCode(owner.getCity(), owner.getLastName(), ownerRepository));`
- Lines 36-41 `nextCustomerCode(...)`: builds `CITY3 + "-" + LAST3 + "-" + %04d sequence`:
  ```java
  String city3 = city.substring(0, Math.min(3, city.length())).toUpperCase();
  String last3 = lastName.substring(0, Math.min(3, lastName.length())).toUpperCase();
  int sequence = countOwnersInCity(city, ownerRepository) + 1;
  return String.format("%s-%s-%04d", city3, last3, sequence);
  ```
- Lines 46-54 `countOwnersInCity(...)`: the per-city sequence (case-insensitive count of existing owners in city).
- Lines 60-70 `countNamesakes(...)`: counts owners with same first+last name (feeds `namesakeCount`, which feeds `membershipLevel`).
- Lines 17-18: registration date defaulted/rolled to a business day before deriving.

### Derived getters on the entity (customerCode consumers: checkDigit, membershipNumber, membershipLevel, locality/region)
**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`** (374 lines)
- Lines 57-58: persisted field `customer_code` / `customerCode`; lines 60-67 `household_id`, `namesake_count`, `postcode`.
- Lines 115-145: getters/setters for `customerCode`, `householdId`, `namesakeCount`, `postcode`.
- Lines 173-176 `getMembershipNumber()`: `customerCode + "-M" + %02d(year%100)` → e.g. `LON-SMI-0007-M26`.
- Lines 183-204 `getCheckDigit()`: Luhn check digit over the **digits in customerCode** (non-digits ignored). Note: the new `<REGION>-<HASH8>` code's hex letters A-F are non-digits and are skipped.
- Lines 212-224 `getMembershipLevel()`: starts at 1; +1 if email present; +1 if `namesakeCount == 0`; capped at 3.
- Lines 230-240: `CITY_REGION` (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD) and `REGION_RANGE` (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) tables.
- Lines 250-257 `getLocality()`: region from postcode range first, else `CITY_REGION`, else `UNKNOWN` — this is the "REGION" the redesign should use.
- Lines 261-273 `regionFromPostcode()`.
- Lines 294-298 `getContactPreference()`.

### Identity key (duplicate detection, telephone/email/household)
**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerIdentity.java`** (43 lines)
- Lines 26-28 `key(...)`: `normalizedTelephone + "|" + email + "|" + householdId`.
- Lines 35-38 `of(Owner)`: re-derives key from stored owner (normalizes phone/email).

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ValidateUniqueIdentity.java`** (30 lines) — the single 409 duplicate gate; lines 21-28 compare identity keys across `ownerRepository.findAll()`.

### Household (SHA-256 hash, membership set)
**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Household.java`** (89 lines)
- Lines 32-39: `record Id(String value)` with `ABSENT` and `isPresent()`.
- Lines 45-56 `membersOf(...)`: household = same normalized last name + address.
- Lines 63-77 `idFor(...)`: **SHA-256** of `lastName + "\n" + address`, takes first 6 bytes → **12 upper-hex chars** (`%02X`). This is the existing hashing pattern; the redesign's HASH8 is 8 hex chars, a parallel but shorter derivation.
- Lines 83-88 `normalize(...)`: trim, collapse whitespace, lower-case.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ResolveHousehold.java`** (36 lines) — publishes `Household.Id`.
**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ApplySharedHousehold.java`** (29 lines) — back-fills householdId onto existing members (transactional).

### Audit
**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`** (25 lines)
- Line 18: dedicated `AUDIT` logger.
- Lines 21-23: `AUDIT.info("Owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}", ...)`. Captured in tests by `AuditLogCapture`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ValidatePostcode.java`** (23 lines) — throws `InvalidPostcodeException` (400).

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** (47 lines) — line 19 imports `OwnerIdentity`; line 24 maps `identityKey` via `OwnerIdentity.of(owner)`. `customerCode`, `checkDigit`, `membershipNumber`, `membershipLevel`, `locality` map automatically from the matching `Owner` getters into the generated `OwnerDto`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When present it
            must be 4 digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), within that region's inclusive
            range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned
            when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. Deprecated and ignored: duplicate detection is now the single
            identityKey check, and because the telephone is part of that key two members of
            the same household with different telephones are always allowed. Owners sharing a
            last name at the same address are grouped under a shared householdId regardless.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region derived from the postcode and city (NSW/VIC/QLD, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone followed by the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned to owners that share a household (same last name at the same address). Owners not in a shared household have no household ID.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and householdId segments are
                empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys
                are equal; such a create is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, shared the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively). Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, fixed at creation. Starts at 1; adds 1 when an email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived first from the postcode by range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither matches.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (counted by registrationDate for the current business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When present it
